premises.evidence_span: driving much of the underlying IT infrastructure into the public cloud

premises.text: Breaches are inevitable regardless of perimeter defenses
premises.evidence_span: The bad guys will find a way in, around, or through your walls, and you will get hacked

premises.text: Traditional encryption imposes significant performance and functionality restrictions
premises.evidence_span: They have significant performance and functionality drawbacks

premises.text: A patented proxy re-encryption cryptosystem with embedded access controls protects data on-prem and in the cloud
premises.evidence_span: With our patented proxy re-encryption cryptosystem, NuCypher is able to protect data wherever it goes, both on-prem and in the cloud

premises.text: Compliance with standards bodies such as NIST and FIPS supports enterprise adoption
